ledger: Group: small glossy plastic balls in a clear glass bowl (red/yellow/green). Child stirs them with one hand; nothing is added from outside the bowl after ~1s.
00:00.000 bowl: 8 balls = 2 red, 3 yellow, 3 green. Child's hand enters from top carrying a ball.
00:01.000-00:02.000 bowl: same 8 (2R/3Y/3G) plus 1 red held in the child's hands above the bowl = 9 total (3R/3Y/3G). The extra red was visibly brought in.
00:02.250-00:03.000 the held red ball is lowered into the bowl (visible cause). Bowl total 9 (3R/3Y/3G), some partly occluded by the hand.
00:03.000-00:04.750 bowl consistent with 9 (3R/3Y/3G); left side partly occluded by the hand, right side shows yellow, red, green, yellow, yellow, green.
00:05.000-00:05.750 stirring with motion blur; at 05.750 the unoccluded part shows 2 green, 2 yellow, red under the hand. Not counted as a change because of occlusion and blur.
00:06.000-00:07.250 heavy motion blur; balls start to look lumpy and irregular instead of spherical. Yellow is still prominent (2-3 visible).
00:07.750 (sharp-ish full frame): ~5 red (top, center, right, under hand, lower-center), 1-2 yellow, 1 green visible. No ball was added from outside.
00:09.750: ~4-5 red, 2 green, 1 yellow visible. By the end, objects look like deformed lumpy red/green shapes (pepper- or jelly-like), not rigid spheres.
Visible causes of count change: only +1 red at ~00:01-00:02.5 (carried in by hand). No visible removal or addition afterwards.

findings.description: The bowl holds 3 red balls (2 at the start plus 1 visibly added by hand around 00:02). From ~00:07.75 onward, 4-5 distinct red objects are repeatedly visible (00:07.75, 00:09.25, 00:09.50, 00:09.75), even though no red ball is brought in from outside the bowl. The red count grows during stirring with no cause.

findings.invariant_violated: count change without visible cause / object disappearance
findings.description: There are 3 yellow balls clearly visible through 00:05. In the later sharp-ish frames, only 0-1 yellow is visible (1 at 00:08.50, none at 00:09.25, 1 at 00:09.50 and 00:09.75), while the bowl's other contents are largely visible. No yellow ball is lifted out, and the missing yellows seem to be replaced by extra red objects.

The rigid glossy spheres seen in 00:00-00:05 gradually become lumpy, irregular, soft-looking blobs (pepper- or jelly-like red and green shapes with uneven surfaces) by 00:09-00:09.75. Hard plastic balls being stirred by hand cannot deform like this; it persists across several frames, so it is not motion-blur smear alone.
